meaning.zh:
“悠哉悠哉，舒适的生活” 或者 “无忧无虑的生活”。

这个短语来源于20世纪早期的美国，最早出现在一首叫做《The Best in the House is None Too Good for Reilly》的流行歌曲中。随后由于20世纪40年代的广播节目《The Life of Riley》的流行，进一步巩固了这一表达。节目讲述了一个普通美国人的轻松愉快的生活，因此这个短语开始被用于描述一种无压力、舒适惬意的生活方式。
meaning.en: This idiom originated in early 20th-century America, first appearing in a popular song called "The Best in the House is None Too Good for Reilly." It was later popularized by a 1940s radio show titled "The Life of Riley," which depicted the easygoing and comfortable life of an average American. Hence, this phrase came to be used to describe a life free from worry and full of comfort.

lines.en: Ever since he won the lottery, he's been living the *life of Riley*.
lines.zh: 自从他中彩票后，他就一直过着悠哉悠哉的生活。

lines.en: After retiring, she finally enjoyed the *life of Riley*.
lines.zh: 退休后，她终于过上了舒适安逸的生活。

lines.en: They spent their vacation at a luxury resort, truly living the *life of Riley*.
lines.zh: 他们在一个豪华度假村度假，真正享受着无忧无虑的生活。
